Description: Unique identification code assigned to each customer transaction (e.g., T1000).
The sequential day number of the operation/recording period (e.g., Day 1 to Day 50).
The specific day of the week when the transaction occurred (e.g., Mon, Tue, Wed, etc.).
The age of the customer making the transaction.
The gender of the customer (e.g., Male, Female).
Indicates whether the customer is a student (Yes) or a non-student (No).
The total number of hours the customer spent using the internet service.
The number of pages printed by the customer during the transaction.
The number of pages scanned by the customer during the transaction.
Indicates whether the customer used the gaming service (Yes) or not (No).
The total monetary value or revenue generated from the transaction.
